title: Petition for Alien Fiancé(e)
summary: Petition to bring your fiancé(e) (K-1) or spouse (K-3) to the United States.

title: Petition for Alien Relative
summary: Petition to sponsor a family member (spouse, child, parent, or sibling) for a green card.

title: Supplemental Information for Spouse Beneficiary
summary: Extra information form for the spouse beneficiary of a Form I-130 petition.

title: Declaration of Financial Support
summary: Promise to financially support someone during a temporary stay in the U.S.

title: Affidavit of Financial Support and Intent to Petition for Legal Custody for Public Law 97-359 Amerasian
summary: Financial support affidavit filed in support of a Form I-360 Amerasian petition.

title: Request to Enforce Affidavit of Financial Support and Intent to Petition for Legal Custody for Public Law 97-359 Amerasian
summary: Request to enforce the financial-support affidavit for a Public Law 97-359 Amerasian.

title: Application for Family Unity Benefits
summary: Request initial benefits under the Family Unity Program, or to request an extension of such benefits.

title: Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA
summary: Sponsor's affidavit of support showing you can financially support an immigrant.

title: Contract Between Sponsor and Household Member
summary: Use this form if you are a household member and want to promise to make your income and/or assets available to help support sponsored immigrants.

title: Sponsor's Notice of Change of Address
summary: Report a sponsor's new address and/or residence.

title: Application to Replace Permanent Resident Card (Green Card)
summary: Replace or renew your green card (Permanent Resident Card).

title: Record of Abandonment of Lawful Permanent Resident Status
summary: Let us know you are voluntarily abandoning your status as a lawful permanent resident (LPR) of the United States.

title: Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
summary: Apply for a green card from inside the U.S. (adjustment of status).

title: Application for Status as a Temporary Resident Under Section 245A of the Immigration and Nationality Act
summary: Apply for temporary resident status under the 1986 IRCA legalization program (now limited to certain settlements).

title: Report of Immigration Medical Examination and Vaccination Record
summary: Immigration medical exam and vaccination record used with a green card application.

title: Application to Adjust Status from Temporary to Permanent Resident (Under Section 245A of the INA)
summary: Adjust from temporary to permanent resident status under the 1986 IRCA amnesty program.

title: Petition to Remove Conditions on Residence
summary: Remove the conditions on a green card you got through marriage.

title: Application to File Declaration of Intention
summary: Use this form if you are a permanent resident and want to declare your intent to become a U.S. citizen.

title: Request for a Hearing on a Decision in Naturalization Proceedings (Under Section 336 of the INA)
summary: Request a hearing before an immigration officer on the denial of your Form N-400, Application for Naturalization.

title: Application for Naturalization
summary: Apply to become a U.S. citizen (naturalization).

title: Request for Certification of Military or Naval Service
summary: This form is used by an applicant for naturalization to request that the Department of Defense verify the applicant's military or naval service.

title: Application to Preserve Residence for Naturalization Purposes
summary: Preserve your continuous residence for naturalization while working abroad for a year or more.

title: Application for Replacement Naturalization/Citizenship Document
summary: Replace a lost, stolen, or incorrect naturalization or citizenship certificate.

title: Application for Certificate of Citizenship
summary: Apply for a Certificate of Citizenship as proof you are a U.S. citizen.

title: Application for Citizenship and Issuance of Certificate Under Section 322
summary: Children who regularly reside in a foreign country may use this form to claim U.S. citizenship based on their parents.

title: Application for Posthumous Citizenship
summary: The certificate establishes only that the person is considered to be a citizen of the United States as of the date of his/her death, and is invalid for all other purposes.

title: Medical Certification for Disability Exceptions
summary: Doctor's certification to request a disability exception to the citizenship test.

title: Employment Eligibility Verification
summary: Employer form to verify a new hire's identity and permission to work in the U.S.

title: Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker
summary: Employer petition for a temporary worker (H-1B, L-1, O-1, and others).

title: Nonimmigrant Petition Based on Blanket L Petition
summary: Classify alien employees as L-1 nonimmigrant intracompany transferees (executives, managers, or specialized knowledge professionals) under a previously approved blanket L petition.

title: Immigrant Petition for Alien Workers
summary: Employer petition for a foreign worker to get an employment-based green card.

title: Immigrant Petition for the Gold Card Program
summary: Petition for an immigrant visa under the Gold Card program established by Executive Order 14351, The Gold Card.

title: Application for Employment Authorization
summary: Apply for a work permit (Employment Authorization Document, or EAD).

title: Application for Employment Authorization for Abused Nonimmigrant Spouse
summary: Certain abused nonimmigrant spouses may use Form I-765V to request an employment authorization document (EAD).

title: Request for Premium Processing Service
summary: Request Premium Processing Service on certain petitions or applications for which this service is available.

title: Application for Entrepreneur Parole
summary: Request parole as a startup entrepreneur whose work offers a significant public benefit.

title: Petition for Amerasian, Widow(er), or Special Immigrant
summary: Self-petition for a green card as a VAWA abuse survivor, widow(er), or special immigrant.

title: Application for Asylum and for Withholding of Removal
summary: Apply for asylum if you fear returning to your country.

title: Refugee/Asylee Relative Petition
summary: Petition to bring your spouse and children to the U.S. as a refugee or asylee.

title: Application for Temporary Protected Status
summary: Apply for Temporary Protected Status (TPS).

title: Consideration of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals
summary: Request or renew DACA (Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals).

title: Application for Suspension of Deportation or Special Rule Cancellation of Removal (Pursuant to Section 203 of Public Law 105-100 (NACARA))
summary: Apply for NACARA suspension of deportation or special-rule cancellation of removal.

title: Application for T Nonimmigrant Status
summary: Apply for a T visa as a victim of human trafficking.

title: Petition for U Nonimmigrant Status
summary: Apply for a U visa as a victim of a serious crime.

title: Petition for Qualifying Family Member of a U-1 Nonimmigrant
summary: Request immigration benefits on behalf of a family member who never held U nonimmigrant status.

title: Application for Replacement/Initial Nonimmigrant Arrival-Departure Document
summary: Replace a lost, stolen, or incorrect I-94 arrival/departure record.

title: Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents, and Arrival/Departure Records
summary: Apply for a travel document — advance parole, a re-entry permit, or a refugee travel document.

title: Application for Carrier Documentation
summary: Request a boarding document to return to the U.S. when a green-card holder's card is lost abroad.

title: Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status
summary: Extend or change your nonimmigrant status (for example, as a visitor or student).

title: Supplemental Information for Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status
summary: Co-applicant supplement filed together with Form I-539.

title: Interagency Record of Request - A, G or NATO Dependent Employment Authorization or Change/Adjustment to/from A, G or NATO Status
summary: Certify or change A, G, or NATO status, or request dependent work authorization.

title: Notice of Appeal to the Board of Immigration Appeals from a Decision of a DHS Officer
summary: Appeal an unfavorable USCIS decision on a Form I-130 or Form I-360 Widow(er).

title: Application for Relief Under Former Section 212(c) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA)
summary: Use this form if you are a lawful permanent resident and wish to file for relief under former INA section 212(c).

title: Application for Advance Permission to Enter as a Nonimmigrant
summary: Ask for advance permission to enter the U.S. as an inadmissible nonimmigrant or a T/U applicant.

title: Application for Waiver of Passport and/or Visa
summary: For an alien who is a legal resident of the United States to reenter the United States without the alien's passport and/or visa.

title: Application for Permission to Reapply for Admission into the United States After Deportation or Removal
summary: Ask permission to reapply for admission after a prior deportation or removal.

title: Notice of Appeal or Motion
summary: Appeal, or file a motion to reopen or reconsider, a denied USCIS decision.

title: Application for Waiver of Grounds of Inadmissibility
summary: Ask USCIS to waive a reason you'd otherwise be barred from a green card or visa.

title: Application for Provisional Unlawful Presence Waiver
summary: Request a provisional waiver of unlawful presence before leaving for a visa interview.

title: Application by Refugee for Waiver of Inadmissibility Grounds
summary: Refugee's request to waive a ground of inadmissibility.

title: Application for Waiver of the Foreign Residence Requirement (under Section 212(e) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, as Amended)
summary: Exchange Visitors (J-1) may file this application to apply for a waiver of the two-year foreign residence requirement of INA Section 212(e).

title: Application for Waiver of Grounds of Inadmissibility Under Sections 245A or 210 of the Immigration and Nationality Act
summary: Apply for a waiver of inadmissibility if you are an applicant for adjustment of status under section 245A or 210 of the Immigration and Nationality Act.

title: Notice of Appeal of Decision Under Sections 210 or 245A of the Immigration and Nationality Act
summary: Appeal a denial under the 1986 IRCA amnesty program to the USCIS Administrative Appeals Office.

title: Petition to Classify Orphan as an Immediate Relative
summary: U.S. citizens use this form to request that USCIS classify an orphan as an immediate relative.

title: Application for Advance Processing of an Orphan Petition
summary: Get pre-approved as a suitable adoptive parent before identifying an orphan to adopt.

title: Petition to Classify Convention Adoptee as an Immediate Relative
summary: Determine the child's eligibility for classification as a Convention adoptee.

title: Application for Determination of Suitability to Adopt a Child from a Convention Country
summary: USCIS uses this form to adjudicate the eligibility and suitability of the applicant(s) who want to adopt a child who is habitually resident in a Hague Adoption Convention country.

title: Immigrant Petition by Standalone Investor
summary: Standalone investor's petition for an EB-5 immigrant investor green card.

title: Immigrant Petition by Regional Center Investor
summary: Regional-center investor's petition for an EB-5 immigrant investor green card.

title: Petition by Investor to Remove Conditions on Permanent Resident Status
summary: Use this form if you are a conditional permanent resident who obtained status through entrepreneurship and want to remove the conditions on your residence.

title: Application for Regional Center Designation
summary: Request an amendment to an approved regional center designated under INA 203(b)(5)(E).

title: Application for Approval of an Investment in a Commercial Enterprise
summary: A designated regional center uses this form to request approval of each particular investment offering through an associated new commercial enterprise.

title: Regional Center Annual Statement
summary: Designated regional centers use this form to provide required information, certifications and evidence to support their continued eligibility for regional center designation.

title: Bona Fides of Persons Involved with Regional Center Program
summary: Attestation of good standing for people involved with an EB-5 regional center.

title: Registration for Direct and Third-Party Promoters
summary: Registration for direct or third-party promoters of EB-5 regional center investments.

title: Alien’s Change of Address Card
summary: Report a change of address to USCIS — required within 10 days of moving.

title: Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative
summary: Notice that an attorney or accredited representative is representing you.

title: Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney in Matters Outside the Geographical Confines of the United States
summary: Notice of appearance for an attorney licensed outside the U.S. in an overseas DHS matter.

title: Biographic Information (for Deferred Action)
summary: Provide biographic information in support of certain deferred-action requests.

title: Verification Request
summary: Verify the immigration status of applications for federal, state, or local public benefits and licenses.

title: Request for the Return of Original Documents
summary: Request the return of original documents submitted to establish eligibility for an immigration benefit.

title: Genealogy Index Search Request
summary: Request a search of USCIS historical indices.

title: Genealogy Records Request
summary: Obtain copies of USCIS historical records.

title: E-Notification of Application/Petition Acceptance
summary: Request a text message and/or email when USCIS accepts your form.

title: Declaration for Interpreted USCIS Interview
summary: Declaration acknowledging the interpreter you bring to a USCIS interview.

title: Authorization for Credit Card Transactions
summary: Pay fees for any form processed at a USCIS lockbox.

title: Request for Certificate of Non-Existence
summary: Determine if specific immigration records exist within our database.

title: Authorization for ACH Transactions
summary: Electronically pay the filing fees and other applicable fees for benefit requests with an Automatic Clearing House (ACH) debit payment from a U.S. bank account.

title: Exemption for Paper Fee Payment
summary: An exemption of the required electronic payment for U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services benefit requests.

title: Request for Cancellation of Public Charge Bond
summary: Request cancellation of a public charge bond for an alien that was submitted on Form I-945, Public Charge Bond.

title: Request for Waiver of Certain Rights, Privileges, Exemptions and Immunities
summary: Waive certain diplomatic rights privileges, exemptions, and immunities associated with your occupational status.

title: Application for Action on an Approved Application or Petition
summary: Request additional action on a previously approved application or petition.

title: Inter-Agency Alien Witness and Informant Record
summary: Law enforcement agencies use Form I-854A to request an alien witness and/or informant receive classification as an S nonimmigrant.

title: Application for Authorization to Issue Certification for Health Care Workers
summary: Use this form if you work with an organization and want to apply for authorization to issue certificates to health care workers.

title: Application for Civil Surgeon Designation
summary: Apply for civil surgeon designation.

title: Request for Fee Waiver
summary: Request a fee waiver if you can't afford the filing fee.

title: Public Charge Bond
summary: Financial bond posted when USCIS finds an applicant inadmissible on public-charge grounds but otherwise admissible.
